soi.text: Mia, a shepherd girl who plans to join the Skiltfolk when she turns fifteen, argues with Wilbur about whether the Gitrog is real, while Elder Kalim announces that he has seen it and that fishing on the lake is suspended.
Her sheep go missing a few at a time, and she writes to her father for help but receives no reply; she then quarrels bitterly with Wilbur and spends a cold, lonely fifteenth birthday.

When her whole flock is slaughtered, she follows huge prints toward the lake, discovers they are faked, and sees hooded villagers loading sheep carcasses onto a ship, with Wilbur among them, before she leaps aboard.

The Gitrog surfaces and devours Kalim, and Mia sets the ship afire and swims ashore with Wilbur, but the Gitrog follows and she falls into its gaze, smiles, and stabs Wilbur with her dagger as an offering.
